name: Shopify
feed: GET https://www.shopify.com/careers (HTML; React Router turbo-stream in window.__reactRouterContext.streamController.enqueue(...), loaderData['($locale)/careers'].jobPostingsWithJobs)
page_total_how: Job links counted on the live pages fetched in the same minute as the feed (2026-10-20T00:25Z): 34 on /careers plus 84 on /careers/disciplines/{engineering-data 50 (rendered client-side from its own embedded list), design 0, product 1, commercial 33}. The one embedded posting not linked anywhere is the evergreen 'Designers' pipeline posting (published 2024-10-07). A Playwright render of /careers a few minutes later showed 33 links because one role ('Tax Lead, Controversy') had been removed by then.
robots: ALLOW /careers, /careers/disciplines/*, /careers/<slug>_<id> (no matching rule); BLOCK /careers/search?* and *.data$ (not used)
notes: Ashby posting API has no 'shopify' board (404); /careers embeds every posting (all disciplines) in its turbo-stream loader data, so one GET covers the whole site. Internships are announced on internships.shopify.com but posted as normal postings on /careers (none open today; the Winter 2027 one is 410 Gone). Never store job.hiringTeam/author (staff names).
